{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of orders) in the segment
conversion_rates = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum']).reset_index()
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates = conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates.iloc[0]['customer_segment']

# Print the full table for evidence
print(conversion_rates)

# Return the segment name
highest_segment"}
